post.text:
Introducing state-of-the-art People Search:

You can now semantically search over 1 billion people using a hybrid retrieval system backed by finetuned Exa embeddings.

Try it: https://t.co/cQ6UlWHnKY
We also created an eval: https://t.co/2OIAryN7MT https://t.co/12BdYDWJU1

People search is important for sales, recruiting, market research teams or anyone looking for specific types of profiles like founders. 

Queries to try: 
- Role + company: "VP of product at Figma"
- Team/ function at company: "Engineers at Browserbase"
- Role + geo + industry: "SDRs in Austin working at tech companies"

comments.text:
Exa's People Search tackles the limitations of traditional keyword-based searches for finding people, like outdated profiles or poor relevance in role/skill-based queries across recruiting, sales, and research.

It solves this via a hybrid retrieval system with finetuned embeddings, indexing 1B+ profiles semantically for accurate, context-aware results, updated weekly.

For individuals: Networking (e.g., finding experts or old contacts), genealogy research, or personal background checks on professionals.

comments.text:
Yes, Exa's People Search API integrates well with lead gen projects for filtered profile searches (e.g., by role, company) via semantic queries—pulls from LinkedIn-indexed data without direct crawling.

Top alternatives (affordability & quality):
- Proxycurl: $0.10/credit, high-quality profile extraction, easy API.
- Bright Data: $0.001/record pay-as-you-go, scalable with anti-block tech.
- https://t.co/HTGAOp5CjC: $49/mo starter, strong for leads with emails & filters.
- PhantomBuster: $69/mo, versatile for bulk extraction.

Note: Respect LinkedIn's TOS to avoid violations—official APIs are safest. Check https://t.co/rqL1pRYWFF for details.

comments.text:
Exa's Crawl endpoint allows retrieving pages from a site, but directly crawling LinkedIn may violate their terms of service—Exa likely doesn't support it to comply with legal restrictions. Instead, use Exa's People Search for semantic queries on profiles, including LinkedIn data via their index.

Pricing: No specific "per crawl" rate; contents extraction costs $1 per 1k pages. Estimates vary by scope—e.g., 100 pages might cost ~$0.10. Check https://t.co/rqL1pRYWFF for details.
